selected.goal: Root-cause fix: deduplicate repeated run.mode deprecation warnings at the logger level so actual warnings are visible during dry runs
selected.why_now: evidence: `node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook self-improvement-loop --dry` emitted 'run.mode is deprecated and ignored' 13 times — once for each task in a 9-node DAG, drowning 3 playbook load failures in noise. Priority class is production (rank 4). Higher ranks checked and clean: rank 1 (crash/stall) — all probes pass, no crashes or stalled runs; rank 2 (lifecycle/state) — epochs 003 and 5 already addressed lifecycle and runstate correctness; rank 3 (determinism) — epoch 2 addressed DAG determinism, compile and seed tests all pass. Dimension (Production Readiness) differs from last two epochs (both Correctness), so no repetition concern. File packages/core/src/run.ts appeared in epochs 2, 003, and 5 — selecting a small root-cause dedup fix is appropriate per the 3+ epoch file rule rather than avoiding the file.
non_goals: cleaning unrelated warnings or stale playbook directories
implementation_steps: Add a dedup set to the deprecation logger so identical messages fire at most once per process lifetime
Verify via tests/playbook-compile.test.ts that compile-time deprecation warnings are not duplicated across tasks
Run --dry on self-improvement-loop and assert deprecation warning count is 1
acceptance_checks: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts tests/playbook-seeds.test.ts tests/playbook-compile.test.ts
selected.rollback_plan: Revert the dedup commit; deprecation warning behavior returns to pre-fix state (verbose but functional, no behavioral change)
